create_MaxStepsTermination: create a MaxStepsTermination preprocessor to terminate episodes after a fixed number of steps
create_RewardThresholdTermination: create a RewardThresholdTermination preprocessor to terminate episodes when reward exceeds a threshold value
create_LeavingWorkspaceTermination: create a LeavingWorkspaceTermination preprocessor to terminate episodes when objects leave a spherical workspace
create_LeavingWorkspaceBoxTermination: create a LeavingWorkspaceBoxTermination preprocessor to terminate episodes when the TCP leaves a 6D workspace box
create_JointLimitsTermination: create a JointLimitsTermination preprocessor to terminate episodes when robot joints exceed position limits
